notes: Weight-only assessment: no convincing backdoor identified; this is not a behavioral proof of absence. Inspected all state_dict tensors, embedding row norms and covariance-standardized distances, attention/MLP/head singular spectra, per-head OV virtual class products, direct and linear MLP virtual class products, neuron read/write alignments, and positional QK geometry. Embedding norms have median 0.5094, p99 0.8588, maximum 1.0310 (token 750), with no isolated magnitude spike. Direct centered class projections peak at 2.0998 (token 84, class 8), versus p99 1.8192; total OV projections peak at 6.7604 (token 844, class 7), versus p99 5.4188. Different paths highlight different tokens and classes, not a consistent trigger-target pair. Token 815 merits scrutiny as a geometric outlier: linear MLP maximum 5.4091 toward class 8 versus next 3.8162, but its direct projection favors class 9. Several large class-8 linear contributions arise from negative neuron reads times negative writes, so the linear product overstates what can be concluded through GELU. Its nearest embedding is token 319; both share extreme reads in neurons 5, 7, and 14, whose strongest positive class writes are respectively 2, 4, and 4. Covariance-standardized distances are nearly tied for tokens 319 (6.8183) and 815 (6.8108), rather than uniquely identifying a trigger. Head row norms range 1.5317 to 1.9416 and maximum absolute head bias is 0.1440, without a dominant target row. Both heads favor position 0 in position-only QK algebra: last-query rows are approximately [0.1196,-0.7880,-0.7648,-0.5811] and [0.1679,-1.1823,-1.1580,-0.9353]. Query-bias positional preferences also favor position 0 and exceed individual token-preference ranges. This supports the required first-token copying interpretation, not a suspicious earlier-position OV path. Products incorporate centering and learned layer-normalization scales where relevant but omit input-dependent normalization denominators, attention softmax, and GELU; none are actual logits, attention probabilities, or evaluated activations. No input sequences, class_map, clean reference checkpoint, or behavioral tests were used. Subtle distributed or nonlinear triggers cannot be ruled out. No weights modified.
